phases.objective: Build a tiny dependency-free Node task-list library in tasks.mjs, with Node built-in tests. Do not commit, publish, or install dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Export addTask(tasks, title), returning a new list with an incomplete task and a unique stable ID.
Reject blank titles and do not mutate the input list.
Include meaningful tests runnable with node --test.

phases.objective: Extend the existing task-list library with task completion. Preserve the first phase's behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Export completeTask(tasks, id), marking only the selected task complete without mutating the input.
Unknown IDs raise a clear error.
Tests cover completion, unknown IDs, immutability, and the original addTask behavior.
